subject.title: fix: recover updater from late launchd bootout errors

question: Should this PR's stop-error-only, roughly 25-second proof policy become canonical, or should its strict proof-source rule be consolidated into the broader updater repair at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/105022?
rationale: Both open branches are plausible but encode different timeout and retry semantics in the same availability-sensitive state machine, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent policy or landing sequence.

options.title: Consolidate one complete repair

options.title: Prefer the broader branch
